fact_types.title: Federal income tax withheld in box 2 of one W-2 slip: keyed by employer, tax year, and the W-2-slip thing, same identity as box 1 (tax.us.2025.w2.box1-wages) but a separate fact and a separate family -- a slip's box 1 and box 2 are each recorded, closed, and aggregated independently (P0 Sec. 3; Track 1 Sec. 2 of the contract). Two same-employer slips are two facts, and a corrected value for the same slip supersedes under this policy (ADR-0011).
Affirmative closure of the W-2 box-2 withholding family at the current membership horizon; independent of the box-1 wages family's own closure.

label: Form W-2 box 2 federal income tax withheld source vocabulary for tax year 2025
